subject: general
question: The Government of India celebrates_______ every year as ‘Civil Services Day’ for the civil servants to rededicate themselves to the cause of citizens and renew their commitment to public service and excellence in work.
solution:
The correct answer is __**21 April.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The government of India celebrates **April 21** every year as** "Civil Services Day".**
 
• This is a** moment for the civil servants to recommit themselves **to the cause of citizens and renew their commitments to** public service and excellence in work.**
 
• **On April 21, 1947**, **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel** label the first batch of Administrative Services at Metcalf House, Delhi, and mentioned them as the **"steel frame of India'. **
 
• **Satyendranath Tagore** was the first Indian who became an Indian Civil Service officer in **1863.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e2a605a0d994b7470efbb5e57ed6dfee3ad5c13a8ae8e99d15b8a01f7e28da9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Civil service responsible for the public administration of the government of a country**​.
 
• It keep out the** legislative, judicial, and military branches.**
 
• Members of the civil service have** no official political allegiance** and are not normally affected by changes of governments.
